_comment: Runtime policy. The client asked for a parameter to control how strict the
assistant is, and accepted a config file rather than a dashboard for it.
strict    - highest refusal rate, lowest hallucination risk. Every
knowledge answer must be strongly supported, and anything
relaxed   - answers more questions, including weakly-supported ones.
More natural to talk to, and more likely to be wrong.
Overrides below take precedence over the preset when set to a number.
